technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring's existing module architecture to integrate the RxJava processor module.
Leverage HDFS High Availability (HA) features for reliable uber-jar storage and retrieval.
Implement ACL functionality using Spring Security's ACL module as a reference.
Use Spark's Java API to manage job lifecycle for stopping existing Spark jobs.
Design configuration overrides for HDFS and YARN locations using Spring's property resolution mechanism.
Profile application startup using Java Flight Recorder and async-profiler for CPU analysis.
assumptions: The project already has a working Spring Framework setup with Java 17+.
HDFS and YARN clusters are pre-configured and accessible.
Spark integration is already in place for job execution.
ACL requirements are limited to basic user-resource privilege mappings.
Performance profiling tools (e.g., JFR, async-profiler) are available in the environment.
Uber-jar storage in HDFS will use a standardized naming convention.

activities.activity_description: Design a flexible RxJava module to act as a processor within the Spring Framework.
Implement core components of the RxJava processor module.
Write unit and integration tests for the RxJava module.
Create documentation for the RxJava module usage and configuration.
Review customer use cases and design ACL specifications for resource access control.
Document ACL design specs, DSL scope, and UI considerations.
Profile admin and container servers to identify CPU startup bottlenecks.
Analyze profiling results and document root causes of high CPU usage.
Document bottleneck reasons, pros/cons of solutions, and next steps.
Design integration for storing custom module uber-jars in HDFS with HA support.
Implement HDFS storage and retrieval logic for uber-jars.
Test HDFS storage reliability and HA failover scenarios.
Design configuration overrides for HDFS and YARN locations.
Implement logic to override HDFS and YARN config locations.
Test configuration override functionality for HDFS and YARN.
Design functionality to stop existing Spark jobs for resource cleanup.
Implement Spark job termination logic using Spark's Java API.
Test Spark job stop functionality and resource cleanup.
